response.message: Astra: You acknowledged that dropping a version removes the comparison, then said you could “always re-introduce” it. What would make that possible after the surrounding context is gone? Leave the mappings unresolved and try a narrow retrieval test: using only your intended carry-forward material, could a later reader identify what was omitted and why? Don’t fill gaps from the current conversation or rewrite the mappings. Decide whether any gap matters for this selection’s purpose before spending more effort.
response.rationale: Shifts from repeated mapping justifications to a bounded test of the assumption that omitted material remains recoverable.
